sections.overview: A tropical South American pimelodid catfish.
sections.identification: Its head and body are notably elongated, the feature reflected in its scientific name.
sections.habitat: It occurs in floodplain lakes, creeks and large rivers, often near aquatic or streamside vegetation.
sections.diet: The species-specific references consulted do not establish its natural diet.
sections.behavior: It is apparently nocturnal and shelters in groups along stream margins during the day.
sections.reproduction: The species description and summaries consulted provide little detail on its breeding biology.
sections.ecology: It occurs alongside S. lima in some basins; its more elongated head and body help distinguish it.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern from 2020.
